item.title: Carr, Young earn All-American honors as Tigers excel at NAIA National Championships
item.description: GAINESVILLE, Fla. — The Campbellsville University men's indoor track & field team delivered an impressive showing at the 2026 NAIA National Championships, hosted at the Alachua County Sports and Events Center. Excelling in the hurdles and horizontal jumps, the Tigers brought home a pair of All-American honors courtesy of Schavon Carr and David Young.

item.title: Crewe-Brown lands historic All-American status
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. – The Campbellsville University women's swimming program celebrated a historic milestone at the 2026 NAIA National Championships this week, as Marlien Crewe-Brown delivered a breakthrough performance on the national stage to earn All-American honors.

item.title: Baseball drops series opener to Talladega despite late-inning surge
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – On Sunday, the Campbellsville University Tigers fell 7-4 to Talladega College in a hard-fought non-conference matchup. The Tigers rallied late in the game but could not overcome an early Talladega offensive surge.

item.title: Crusenberry leads Tigers to split in series-ending day facing Talladega
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – On Monday, the Campbellsville University Tigers split their matchup with Talladega College, falling 8-0 in the first game, before bouncing back with a 2-0 victory behind a dominant pitching performance from Tristin Crusenberry.

item.title: Tigers trade blows with Bulldogs, emerge triumphant
item.description: BARBOURVILLE, Ky. – On Tuesday, the (RV) Tigers secured a 9-7 midweek victory over Union Commonwealth, picking up momentum before entering conference play. After trading runs throughout the early and middle innings, the Tigers broke through with a key three-run inning in the seventh inning and held off a late rally from the Bulldogs to close out the win.

item.title: Volleyball sticks 4th in latest NAIA Ranking
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. — The Campbellsville University men's volleyball team continues its march through an unprecedented 2026 campaign, holding firm at #4 in the latest NAIA Men's Volleyball Coaches' Top 15 Poll released Wednesday by the national office.

item.title: 5 Tigers set to compete at 2026 NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships
item.description: PARK CITY, Kan. – The postseason has officially arrived for the #17 Campbellsville University women's wrestling team. Five Lady Tigers are bound for the Heartland Credit Union Arena in Park City, Kansas, ready to compete against the best in the country at the 2026 NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championship on March 13-14.

item.title: Lady Tigers earn #2 seed; set to host NAIA 1st & 2nd Round
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The road to the Red Banner runs through the Powell Athletic Center. After compiling a 22-7 overall record and receiving an at-large bid, the Campbellsville University Lady Tigers have earned a #2 seed in the Liston Quadrant for the 2026 NAIA Women's Basketball Championship First and Second Rounds, presented by Ballogy.
